title: Specialized Runnable Implementations
summary: This module provides advanced `Runnable` implementations for dynamic configuration, managing chat history, passing data through pipelines, loading components from the LangChain Hub, and routing based on OpenAI function calls.

nodes.label: Dynamically Configure Runnable
nodes.title: DynamicRunnable
nodes.description: Allows a `Runnable` to be dynamically configured at runtime, delegating execution to an underlying runnable based on the provided configuration.

nodes.label: Manage Chat History
nodes.title: RunnableWithMessageHistory
nodes.description: Wraps a `Runnable` to automatically manage and persist chat message history, using a configurable session history factory.

nodes.label: Pass Through & Assign Data
nodes.title: RunnablePassthrough
nodes.description: Acts as an identity function for `Runnable`s, passing inputs through directly or allowing additional keys to be assigned to the output dictionary.

nodes.label: Load Runnable from Hub
nodes.title: HubRunnable
nodes.description: Retrieves and instantiates a `Runnable` from the LangChain Hub, allowing for versioned and shared runnable components.

nodes.label: Route to OpenAI Function Calls
nodes.title: OpenAIFunctionsRouter
nodes.description: Routes incoming messages to specific `Runnable`s or callables based on the output of OpenAI function calling, enabling dynamic tool selection.

nodes.label: Handle Async Exceptions
nodes.title: wrapper (config.py)
nodes.description: Catches and converts `StopIteration` exceptions to `RuntimeError` to prevent issues in asynchronous operations within runnables.

nodes.label: Base Runnable Interface
nodes.title: Runnable
nodes.description: The fundamental interface for all runnable components in LangChain, defining methods for invocation, streaming, and batch processing.

nodes.label: Serializable Runnable
nodes.title: RunnableSerializable
nodes.description: A base class for runnables that can be serialized and deserialized, enabling persistence and sharing of runnable configurations.

nodes.label: Runnable with Bound Config
nodes.title: RunnableBindingBase
nodes.description: A base class for runnables that bind to a specific configuration or another runnable, often used for wrapping or modifying behavior.

nodes.label: Chat Message History Store
nodes.title: BaseChatMessageHistory
nodes.description: Abstract base class for storing and retrieving chat messages, providing an interface for conversational memory.

nodes.label: Prompt Messages (Human/AI)
nodes.title: BaseMessage, HumanMessage, AIMessage
nodes.description: Core message types used in conversational AI, representing different roles in a dialogue (e.g., human input, AI response).

nodes.label: LangChain Hub
nodes.title: LangChain Hub
nodes.description: An external repository for sharing and discovering LangChain components, including prompts and runnables.

nodes.label: OpenAI Function Definitions
nodes.title: OpenAIFunction
nodes.description: Structured definitions of functions that can be called by OpenAI models, enabling tool use and structured output.

nodes.label: JSON Output Parser
nodes.title: JsonOutputFunctionsParser
nodes.description: Parses JSON output from language models, specifically designed to extract function call information.

groups.label: Surface Components
groups.title: User-Facing Runnable Implementations
groups.description: These runnables provide direct functionality for common use cases like chat history, data manipulation, and external component loading.

groups.label: Core Runnable Logic
groups.title: Foundational Runnable Orchestration
groups.description: Components that enable dynamic behavior and configuration within the runnable ecosystem.

groups.label: Utilities
groups.title: Internal Helper Functions
groups.description: Small, focused components that provide supporting functionality for other runnables, often related to error handling or configuration.
